svg.title: P03: Asynchronous state machine collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A1 · state role collaboration
A harness run may pause for external work or user
An event requests suspension or arrives to resume
A resumed run follows only the legal transition
State can be serialized or retained and
Accepted events move the machine to a
defined state and duplicate events are
No transition crosses from a disallowed
state or executes twice after replay.
leave a recoverable state or raise
1 start(run) → 2 persist(state) → 3 restore(state) → 4 resume(event) → 5 on_error(error) → 6 recover(state)
Evidence: 38/41 repositories, 34/36 families; 38 trajectories (19 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Transition dispatch, persistence backend, and recovery policy.
Negative control: An enum without transition enforcement is not sufficient.
